conclusion: In this work, we show that 1-shot RLVR is sufficient to trigger substantial improvements in reasoning tasks, even matching the performance of RLVR with thousands of examples. The empirical results reveal not only improved task performance but also additional observations such as post-saturation generalization, cross-category generalization, more frequent self-reflection and also additional analysis. These findings suggest that the reasoning capability of the model is already buried in some base models, and encouraging exploration on a very small amount of data is capable of generating useful RL training signals for igniting these LLM’s reasoning capability. It also demonstrates the anti-overfitting property of the RLVR algorithm with zero-mean advantage, as we can train on a single example millions of times without performance degradation.
